zoomiesGhostingFindings: Renderer clears the canvas every frame (no blending). Run frames register the torso, not the head: after RunningMotion offsets the nose still moves 34 native px across the cycle with 24-25 px steps between consecutive frames, and run_left head top bobs 69 native px. 18 frames in 0.4 s is 45 fps, which does not divide the render timer, so frames are skipped unevenly. Both read as ghosting/shake. Candidate fixes: head-registered offsets, fewer/slower frames, or new run art.
